title: Skyline House
description:
Experience one of Nashville’s most breathtaking skyline views. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame the city lights from this stunning contemporary retreat featuring soaring 25-foot ceilings, abundant natural light, a chef’s kitchen, grand piano, and designer furnishings throughout. Whether you’re visiting for a relaxing getaway, celebration, business trip, or Music City adventure, you’ll enjoy luxury, comfort, and unforgettable views just minutes from Nashville’s top attractions.

The space
Each room offers its own unique character and comfort. The primary suite features a dramatic wall of glass with sweeping views of Nashville, creating a luxury penthouse feel. For guests who prefer complete darkness, a custom blackout curtain covers the entire window wall. Wake up to stunning sunrises or enjoy falling asleep beneath the city lights.

The upstairs guest suite is warm, stylish, and inviting, featuring a king bed and daybed for additional sleeping space. Rich textures, thoughtful design, and comfortable furnishings create a relaxing retreat.

The downstairs guest bedroom offers two queen beds and a clean, functional layout with designer touches throughout. Green and gold accents carry seamlessly from the bedroom into the adjoining bath.

The open-concept living area is the heart of the home, connecting the spacious kitchen and living room into one welcoming gathering space. Whether you’re enjoying a meal, relaxing with friends, or taking in the views, the home is designed for comfort, connection, and memorable stays.

Guest access
The home is yours apart from the basement/ garage where storage and cleaning supplies are stored
